interface_detail: The deno deploy command-line interface (a subcommand of the deno CLI) for creating and deploying apps, and the console.deno.com web dashboard
tooling: the deno CLI, subcommand deno deploy (create, deploy and manage apps)
chaining: A perpetual 1M-request front that can hold secrets, run cron and talk to an IPv6-only VPS behind it; it is the IPv4 face for a Hax box, and it costs nothing at that request rate.

limits.value: idle apps shut down after about 20 to 30 seconds
10 hours of active CPU and 150 GiB-hours of memory a month

limits_note: 10 hours of active CPU a month is the wall: an always-resident process cannot exist because idle apps are shut down after 20 to 30 seconds, so the 10 hr is spent by request handling and cron-triggered work, not by uptime.
binding_note: the 20 to 30 second idle shutdown means there is no resident process to bill, so the CPU grant is spent by requests rather than by uptime.

identity_cost.detail: a Deno Deploy account; no card on the Free plan

reliability_note: a cold start follows every idle period; CPU is not consumed while the app waits on I/O, so the meter is friendlier than the wall clock suggests
